Adult tags recorded fish depths typically 326-553 m (median 446 m), with a 12-1,621 m range and diel vertical migration. The configured 100-500 m range overlaps the adult core but misses much deeper adult habitat and juvenile pelagic habitat; tagged fish depth is not identical to seabed depth.
